title: Microsoft is enabling a Windows 11 security feature that can hurt gaming performance
summary: If you want to check whether memory integrity is enabled on your Windows 11 PC, you can type ‘Core Isolation’ into Windows search and then open the result and toggle memory integrity on or off in the Windows security app.
